name: Distraction
subtitle: ohh noes!!!!1
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – Deplete the character.
flavor: "I keep an extra severed head handy for just such an occasion..."
notes: Catalog uses EXTRA COST templating. Footer has www.thespoils.com in place of an artist credit.

name: Penetrate
subtitle: sometimes a ram is just a ram
rules: COST – Pick an attacking character you control. -- EFFECT – If the character would assign battle damage to the blocking party during this battle, assign that damage to the faction or location being attacked instead.
notes: Card prints 'assign that damage to the faction or location being attacked instead'; catalog has 'assign it to the target of the attack instead'. Catalog uses EXTRA COST templating. Footer has www.thespoils.com in place of an artist credit.

name: Anxious Oaf
subtitle: BUH-NEE!
rules: When an attacking or blocking party is formed that includes this card, it must have at least 2 members.
flavor: "Castle Direstock? Most people never even make it past the rabbits."
notes: Card prints 'formed that includes this card'; catalog has 'formed including this card'. Footer has www.thespoils.com in place of an artist credit.

name: Thundering Nilpha
subtitle: crushing coils of carnage
rules: While this card is the only member of an attacking party that is attacking a location, it gains 1 strength and cannot be blocked.
flavor:
Smashed into pulp, dashed to bloody ribbons on the rocks, spined and impaled, devoured and ingested, boiled alive in the churning belly of the demon.
Good times.
notes: Card requires this card to be the ONLY member of an attacking party attacking a location; catalog says only 'While this card is attacking a location'. Footer has www.thespoils.com in place of an artist credit.

name: Unexpected Boobysnake
subtitle: nobody expects the unexpected boobysnake!
rules: You may play this card whenever you could play a tactic. If you do, discard a card or destroy this card.
notes: Card has no TACTICAL keyword: 'You may play this card whenever you could play a tactic. If you do, discard a card or destroy this card.' (penalty whenever it is played as a tactic). Catalog has TACTICAL plus 'When this card enters play, if you deployed it during an opponent's turn, discard a card or destroy this card', which restricts the penalty to opponent's turns. Footer has www.thespoils.com in place of an artist credit.
